name: ima-knowledge-kit
description: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork via the official ima OpenAPI. Ships a copy of the official ima-skill for offline install, can fetch the latest release on demand, and guides first-run credential setup.
descriptionEn: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork via the official ima OpenAPI. Ships a copy of the official ima-skill for offline install, can fetch the latest release on demand, and guides first-run credential setup.
descriptionZh: 基于 ima 官方 OpenAPI，把腾讯 ima（ima.copilot）的笔记与知识库接入千问办公。随包提供官方 ima-skill 副本（可离线安装），也支持从官方 zip 按需拉取最新版，并引导首次凭证配置。
